_comment: Versioned deployment manifest for Stellar testnet. Pakta_Dia0_Dev1.md §2 requires the Proof-of-Payable Builder and the Settlement Adapter to read asset_contract_id from a manifest rather than hardcoding it, so that registration_digest is always bound to the deployment it was issued for. Public identifiers only — no seeds, ever.

asset._comment: Demo asset issued by Pakta for the hackathon. NOT Circle USDC. Pakta_Plan_Web3_Stellar.md D5: going to mainnet is a change of this manifest, not of code.

payableGate._comment: Deployed but NOT initialized. `initialize` is the single call that picks the custody model (Pakta_Plan_Web3_Stellar.md D1): set `payer` to this contract id for the vault model, or to an external treasury account to require its signature on every settle. Same code either way, so the decision stays open without blocking the build.

payableGateScaffold._comment: HU-D1-01 toolchain scaffold, superseded by payableGate. Kept because the pinned registration_digest parity vector is bound to this contract id.

trustlines._comment: Friendbot only funds XLM. Every account that receives the demo USDC needed an explicit change-trust first — the Semana 2 risk flagged in Pakta_Dia0_Dev1.md §1.

verification._comment: Transactions proving the asset path works end to end, before any contract logic exists.
verification.sacTransferNote: 5000.0000000 USDC (50000000000 units) distributor -> VEN-001, the exact INV-001 amount from Pakta_Documento_Maestro.md §25. Emitted a `transfer` event, which is the shape the Event Indexer will consume.
